name: Project Outbreak Infection
author: Project Outbreak
summary: An optional infection system for Project Outbreak that turns infected into Zombies.
description:
When bitten, infection  develops over time and can spread through coughing. Dedicated medical equipment lets players test for infection before symptoms worsen. Early treatment can clear it. Suppressants only buy time. If an infected character dies, the same body can return as a zombie.

Requires Project Outbreak. Released under the Arma Public License (APL).

For questions, join the Discord Server: 
https://discord.gg/JumfhFujRF
changelog:
1.3.1
Infection stage popups are off by default. Game Masters and server owners can enable them with Show Symptom Alerts or outbreak.json. Examination, diagnosis and treatment feedback remain available.

When symptom alerts are enabled, the risen notification now reaches the original player after their old body reanimates. Includes updated Workshop information and component licence clarification.

name: Project Outbreak Breach
author: Project Outbreak
summary: An optional destruction system that lets zombie pursuits continue through buildings and compounds by breaking doors and windows.
description:
Breach makes defensive positions less predictable. Zombies can batter through doors and turn windows into climbable openings. Fences can also give way under pressure. 


Requires Project Outbreak. Released under the Arma Public License (APL).

For questions, join the Discord Server: 
https://discord.gg/JumfhFujRF
changelog:
1.3.2
- Breach allows zombies to finish a wall approach or active climb.
- Zombies can open a usable door in either direction before breaching it.

name: Project Outbreak Gadgets
author: Project Outbreak
summary: An equipment pack that gives players more options when a horde closes in.
description:
Gadgets adds practical tools that change the flow of an encounter. Draw zombies away with sound. Hold ground with fire or an electric fence. The recoverable M48 Talon Spear works up close and can also be thrown when distance matters.

Credits and third-party licences:
The spear movement is adapted from https://www.fab.com/listings/fffbea69-14ff-499d-b85a-131171c1d6f8  by Bacengdu under the Fab Standard License. 
- Spear throw sound adapted from "spear_thrust (6)" by Yodguard, from Pixabay, used under the Pixabay Content License. https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/film-special-effects-spear-thrust-6-382403/


Requires Project Outbreak. Original Gadgets content is released under the Arma Public License (APL).

For questions, join the Discord Server: 
https://discord.gg/JumfhFujRF
changelog:
- Hotfix for Electric fence sections causing crash.
- Fixed a false warning from the Defense Supplies crate’s stock check.
- Fixed errors during napalm cleanup when burned zombies disappear. The flames and burned appearance stay the same, with less background work. It should be faster now!

name: Project Outbreak Variety
author: Project Outbreak
summary: Optional Project Outbreak zombie appearances, including many new Zombie skins.
description:
Adds the optional normal-sized zombie appearance families for Project Outbreak. Install Project Outbreak first, then this pack.

Credits and third-party licences:
- Zombies Pack V4, Zombie Male AAB, Giant Zombie (Nephilim) and Decayed Zombie B by Studio New Punch, from Fab, used under the Fab Standard License. Modified and rigged for Arma Reforger.
-  A huge thank you also goes to AlienBallien (BallienCreatures) for  native creature ragdoll approach, extremely helpful for custom creatures in this mod and was used under APL.
changelog:
1.1.0
- Added a decayed female firefighter with repaired worn gear, finer hair, a readable FIRE helmet badge, fitted straps and a weathered breathing tank.
- A direct bullet hit on her breathing tank releases one short-range pressure blast that damages nearby characters, with a bang, air, dust and small cosmetic chips, without flames. It is designed to happen once per tank. Hits to the rest of the body do not trigger it, and the cylinder stays attached and visually intact afterward.

name: Special Zombies and Creatures
author: Project Outbreak
summary: Optional Project Outbreak special zombies and creatures, including the Nephilim and Nightingale.
description:
Adds optional special zombies and creatures to Project Outbreak. 

Current Roster:
- (NEW) the Abomination, multiheaded freak. He only goes down if you kill all his heads (credit to Ghost35643 for concept!)
- the Nephilim, a towering giant zombie with shirtless or military appearances, brutal throws, contact chokes, knockdown attacks
- the Nightingale, a crying Half-Zombie who attracts hordes and runs away, hides inside buildings, closes doors, and uses her screams to knock nearby survivors down. Eliminate her to stop the horde!
 

Credits and third-party licences:
- Giant Zombie (Nephilim) by Studio New Punch, from Fab, used under the Fab Standard License. Modified and rigged for Arma Reforger.
- Zombie Female: Nurse (the Nightingale) from Fab, used under the Fab Standard License.
- Nephilim vocals: Zombies Sound Pack by artisticdude (CC0 1.0). https://opengameart.org/content/zombies-sound-pack
- Nightingale vocal "Crying female low tone Voice Over" by JeanMyna_VA (OpenGameArt), licensed CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/), edited. https://opengameart.org/content/crying-female-low-tone-voice-over-vocal-sound-for-character
- Further Nightingale vocal sources under CC0 1.0, with thanks: WuxiaScrub, tcrocker68, AlucardsBride, RebekahDay, purplereptar, Samusasi, Pennywind.
- Nightingale body base: MakeHuman hm08 topology and skin data (CC0 1.0); joepal_plain_bra (CC0); mindfront_nails_01_short by Mindfront (CC0 1.0).
changelog:
1.1.3
- New Nightingale cries, screams and death sounds.
- Balanced the loudness of individual takes within each voice type.
- Added Nightingale swing sounds. Her horde-calling scream keeps its existing behavior.

name: Project Outbreak Deadwood
author: Project Outbreak
summary: A Zombie Apocalypse PvE Project Outbreakscenario on the Glenwood terrain.
description:
The undead have fully taken over Glenwood, a small American town. It's your job to retake it for the living. 

WHAT THIS IS 
- A PvE scenario on the Glenwood terrain, with the town dressed for the outbreak. 
- The infected are always there. They do not wait for a Game Master to place them. 
- Bases and radio relays across the map to take and hold, and a fixed main base to start from. 
- You fight the infected. 

WHO MADE THE PARTS 

The outbreak mode is KdK Outbreak Zombie PVE by KdK CaptHero: its director, spawners, objectives and Game Master panel are what runs here. The dressed town is Dead Glenwood by Windy768, on the Glenwood terrain by vap3r, with Placeables for GM by Heine.CRV. The base layout follows MODERN PVE | GLENWOOD by guennyyy. Thank you to all of them; this scenario only arranges their work under APL.
changelog: Taking a district stops its local infected reinforcements; roaming infected can still enter. Graves stop preparing new waves when an attack ends. Nearby infected remain, while abandoned groups clear after everyone leaves. The compact campaign map keeps bases and relays, with field orders in the journal. Joining screens show US Army Remnants. Enemy score icons and flags use the black-and-red Outbreak banner. Infection and Ambience opening overlays default to off. Selected barriers have openings while surrounding fence runs remain. Tunnels have been updated, but zombie movement and spawning underground are still under testing and are not yet reliable.

name: Project Outbreak Deadwood Lite
author: Project Outbreak
summary: A lighter Project Outbreak Deadwood: the same self-running PvE zombie scenario on the Glenwood terrain, with only Project Outbreak and the map as dependencies.
description:
Glenwood is a small American town, and it has gone under. This is the Lite build of Project Outbreak Deadwood: the same scenario, with a much smaller download.

WHAT THIS IS
- A PvE scenario on the Glenwood terrain, with the town dressed for the outbreak.
- The infected are always there. They do not wait for a Game Master to place them.
- Bases and radio relays across the map to take and hold, and a fixed main base to start from.
- You fight the infected.

WHAT IS DIFFERENT FROM PROJECT OUTBREAK DEADWOOD
- It needs only Project Outbreak (with Creature Melee AI and Infection) and the Glenwood map content. About 1.9 GB in total.
- It does not include KdK Outbreak, or the extra weapons, vehicles and equipment add-ons. Use your own server mod pack for those.
- Without KdK Outbreak there is no extra loot, no cap on the infected population and no automatic cleanup. Your own mod pack can add them.
- This build has not had a full playtest yet. Please report problems.
- Use it instead of Project Outbreak Deadwood, not together with it. Both share the same scenario content.

WHO MADE THE PARTS
The dressed town is Dead Glenwood by Windy768, on the Glenwood terrain by vap3r, with Placeables for GM by Heine.CRV. The base layout follows MODERN PVE | GLENWOOD by guennyyy. The infected and the melee creatures come from Project Outbreak and Creature Melee AI. Thank you to all of them; this scenario only arranges their work under APL.
changelog: Objectives and capture now advance through neighboring bases instead of opening the whole map. Each base you hold opens its linked neighbors, with several routes available. Distant bases and relays cannot be captured early. Losing the last supporting neighbor cancels that objective and interrupts capture; infected-held targets reopen when a route is available again.

name: Goblin Swordsman
author: Project Outbreak
summary: Small sword-carrying creatures travel in groups. A larger crimson Blademaster wears layered armour and carries a dark, red-marked blade. Requires Creature Melee AI.
description:
Groups of small, sinewy creatures have been observed carrying worn swords and scraps of armour. They close distance quickly and respond to gunfire with guarded movements. How they obtain their equipment remains unconfirmed.


The larger Blademaster has crimson skin, an exposed horned face and black lacquered armour laced in red. Faint red fissures become visible in darkness, while brighter markings run along his sword. Short rushes and successive cuts make an approaching group difficult to keep at a distance.


Part of the Creatures collection.


Includes Goblin Swordsman, Goblin Swordsman (Bare), Goblin Blademaster (Boss) and Goblin Warband (4). Requires the separately installed Creature Melee AI framework. No Project Outbreak gameplay addon is required.


Original goblin, bamboo sword, textures and animations by RamsterZ, from Agile swordsman Anims, acquired under the Fab Standard License: https://www.fab.com/listings/3f4aadff-0a2c-46db-a17b-25bac0c352eb. License: https://www.fab.com/eula. Project Outbreak adapted the assets, retargeted the animations and authored the gameplay, materials and interface.


Big thanks to AlienBalien for the custom ragdolling work in BallienCreatures, used as a workflow reference: https://reforger.armaplatform.com/workshop/6534B9CEB6D12EE7-BallienCreatures. Reference license: Arma Public License, https://www.bohemia.net/en/licenses/arma-public-license.


Creature Melee AI is by Project Outbreak and retains its credit to Sanxisan's Melee Combat Extended work: https://reforger.armaplatform.com/workshop/6595113A3678CF5D-MeleeCombatExtended. Sword swing sounds were generated by Project Outbreak with ElevenLabs. Arma Reforger, Enfusion and base-game resources are by Bohemia Interactive.


Original assets remain the property of their creators. The package grants no right to extract or redistribute the Fab assets, and their NoAI restriction remains applicable. See the included license.txt and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for component terms.


Workshop licence: Arma Public License (APL). Incorporated assets retain their original licences and credits; this listing does not grant additional rights to those assets. See the included notices for component terms.

name: Warbeasts
author: Project Outbreak
summary: Witnesses report horned humanoids carrying paired axes, alongside heavier fist-fighting forms. Their equipment varies from bone tools to scavenged military kit, a white vest and denim.
description:
Warbeasts were first reported by civilians living near abandoned military positions. Witnesses described pale, horned humanoids with unusually large arms, carrying an axe in each hand. Further sightings were reported along rural roads and at the edges of nearby settlements.

The smaller Warbeast carries paired bone axes. The larger Warchief wears military field equipment and carries steel tactical axes. The Greenskin has a broad jaw, flat nose, lower tusks and green leathery skin. It carries the smaller Warbeast's paired bone axes. Its equipment is thought to have been scavenged from abandoned military stores, although this remains unconfirmed.

Squidbeast has mottled hide and enlarged fists. It strikes with heavy punches and downward smashes. A larger orange form, called Big Jim in local reports, wears a white vest and denim. The remains of metal restraints hang from their wrists; their origin is unconfirmed.

They pursue nearby targets and attack at close range. The Warchief has sufficient strength to throw cars with a strike, shove trucks and, in some cases, overturn armoured vehicles. Entering a vehicle does not end the pursuit. The creature will attack the vehicle while its target remains inside.

Part of the Creatures collection. Available through Game Master, with direct control of the axe-wielding creatures and both Squid variants with their fist and smash attacks. Requires Creature Melee AI 1.8.0 or newer.

Big thanks to AlienBalien for the custom ragdolling work that informed these creatures. BallienCreatures is shared under the Arma Public License (APL): https://reforger.armaplatform.com/workshop/6534B9CEB6D12EE7-BallienCreatures. Licence: https://www.bohemia.net/en/licenses/arma-public-license.

Character assets: Epic Games, acquired under the Fab Standard License. Squidbeast and Big Jim use adapted Rampage character assets, original animation curves and nonverbal voices. Authoring assets and standalone asset redistribution are excluded.

Axes: tactical tomahawk source model from Melee Combat Extended Resources by TonyFierce / Anton Firsenko (MCE author Sanxisan). The source model collection is credited under CC BY 4.0 to tubataigames, Marco Orazio Grasso, Hovl Studio, Edwin Wagha, CaptainHC, MaX3Dd, Dasamura, Eric Wallbank, FJH, Foxx Assets and Ruslan Maer. Changes include hand fit, a 180-degree rotation, rubber grips, a sharper cutting bevel and adapted steel finish.
Source: https://github.com/TonyFierce/Melee-Combat-Extended-Resources/tree/efdd94028de3e0517771183d39b4124ee94738f0
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Workshop licence: Arma Public License (APL). Incorporated assets retain their original licences and credits; this listing does not grant additional rights to those assets. Complete component notices are included.
changelog:
1.0.3
Greenskin gains a broad jaw, flat nose, lower tusks, a heavier brow and leathery green hide. Fuller cheeks, softer facial creases and smoother face-to-neck skin transitions give it a more natural appearance. Removed its old crown and back spikes. The original Warbeast and Warchief remain available.

Barefoot Warbeast and Warchief no longer injure their feet while walking or running with the updated Creature Melee AI dependency.

Warbeast, Warchief and Greenskin now have health sliders in the shared Creatures settings of Game Master global attributes.

The shared Creatures faction label now keeps the standard Game Master faction setup, so it works better with other mods that add factions. Requires Creature Melee AI 1.8.0.

Adds Squidbeast and Big Jim to the Creatures roster. Squidbeast uses the original mottled hide; Big Jim has orange hide, a white vest, denim and a larger body. Both use fist and smash attacks, creature voices and native turning.

name: Eyekin
author: Project Outbreak
summary: Pale, one-eyed organisms strike with claws and charged eye beams. A many-eyed Titan towers over settlements, while the winged form hunts from above and carries people away.
description:
Eyekin are pale humanoid organisms dominated by a single enlarged eye. Their origin is unknown. Individuals differ in size and iris colour. At close range they use rapid claw strikes; larger individuals can discharge a visibly charged eye beam with an explosive impact. Solid cover blocks the beam.


The Titan stands 21 metres tall and has twelve independent eye weak points. It stomps nearby prey and fires lasers from surviving eyes. Body hits cannot kill it; every eye must be defeated. Defeated eyes close and remain bloodshot. After half its eyes are defeated, the AI Titan starts running; players can run at any time.


A winged form stands 2.4 metres tall, with pink skin, a hooked beak and powerful legs. It runs into takeoff and alternates between heavy wingbeats and an almost horizontal glide. During a prey dive, its neck extends forward and its legs stretch out. People can be seized in the beak or lifted by the talons and dropped from height. Against airborne helicopters, the bird grips a reachable skid or hull point and hauls the aircraft down.


Part of the Creatures collection.


Available through Game Master, with player control and separate durability settings for all four forms. Bird groups of 4 and 16 are available. Laser Launch Chance controls how often eligible laser hits give a brief upward ragdoll shove; it defaults to 5%, and 0 disables it. Fire slaps with the humanoids and stomps with the Titan; V fires an eye laser on the larger humanoid or Titan. Bird controls: Space climbs or takes off, C descends, WASD steers, V toggles flight, G grabs or releases, and Fire slaps on the ground or strikes with the legs in flight. Forward + C above 8 metres begins a dive. Flight and grab controls have gamepad bindings.


Requires Creature Melee AI 1.8.0.


Big thanks to AlienBalien for the custom ragdolling work that informed these creatures. BallienCreatures is shared under the Arma Public License (APL): https://reforger.armaplatform.com/workshop/6534B9CEB6D12EE7-BallienCreatures. Licence: https://www.bohemia.net/en/licenses/arma-public-license.


Retargeted slap animations: Zombie_Pack, purchased under the Fab Standard License (https://www.fab.com/eula); compiled embedded game content only. Laser audio: Mixkit's Cinematic laser gun thunder, under the Mixkit Sound Effects Free License (https://mixkit.co/license/#sfxFree). Wing sound design and bird vocals: owner-generated recordings under a paid ElevenLabs plan (https://elevenlabs.io/sound-effects). Complete component notices are included.


Workshop licence: Arma Public License (APL). Incorporated assets retain their original licences and credits; this listing does not grant additional rights to those assets. See the included notices for component terms.
changelog:
1.2.2
Fixed the Bird blocking ordinary soldier controls during its hunt. Shooting, jumping, vaulting and interactions stayed working in the owner's local playtest.

Fixed Game Master selection and placement for the existing Eyekin groups. Added Bird groups of 4 and 16.

Added Laser Launch Chance in the global Creatures settings and Creatures.json. It defaults to 5%; 0 disables the small upward ragdoll shove. Ordinary laser damage and recovery are preserved.

The Bird now circles before diving at a person and misses if they move after its final approach. Added idle, distant, aggressive and attack vocals. Fixed its blank Game Master portrait and self-inflicted claw wounds in flight.

Added the Titan's own portrait and improved its hand pose. AI Titans start running after half their eyes are defeated; players can run at any time. Requires Creature Melee AI 1.8.0.

name: Maulkin
author: Project Outbreak
summary: A lean, fast creature that closes on prey and fights at close range.
description:
Maulkin is a lean, fast organism that hunts in short bursts. Its hide is a smooth pink, crossed by blue and purple veins that show through the skin. It is lightly built and moves low to the ground, closing on prey rather than holding distance.


Part of the Creatures collection.

Licence: https://www.bohemia.net/en/licenses/arma-public-license. name: Creature Melee AI
author: Project Outbreak
summary: Shared creature AI for Arma Reforger: hostile targeting, pursuit, melee, carry support and reusable animations. Includes authoring templates and optional Game Master examples.
description:
Creature Melee AI (CMAI) is a reusable creature-AI framework for Arma Reforger. A Character-compatible entity can acquire an eligible hostile Character, pursue it continuously through native navigation, and request an attack through a replaceable attack contract.


AUTHORING
Create a creature from one inherited prefab and one inherited settings file. CMAI owns the common targeting, pursuit, scheduler, damage-request, cleanup, and replication infrastructure while a project can replace the creature presentation and attack behavior.


INTEGRATION
Public settings, APIs, and capability hooks support independent creature projects. Optional Slow, Hunter, and Fast examples are supplied for sandbox testing. Their Game Master cards use the non-playable Melee AI faction and remain disabled unless a maintainer deliberately enables the single integration switch.


SCOPE
CMAI depends only on the Arma Reforger Base Game. Project Outbreak is not required. CMAI does not provide a spawner, wave manager, population director, or scenario lifecycle; those remain responsibilities of the consuming project.


CREDITS
Retargeted zombie locomotion, attacks, feeding and reactions: Zombie_Pack, purchased under the Fab Standard License (https://www.fab.com/eula). Throw/carry animations: RamsterZ Free Anims Volume 1: https://www.fab.com/listings/9319491d-0e91-422c-9b67-ad4bf6c01a02. These compiled animations are embedded game content; their source assets are not included.


Melee animation: Melee Combat Extended by Sanxisan (Anton Firsenko / TonyFierce). Five compiled two-handed clips retain the Arma Public License: https://reforger.armaplatform.com/workshop/6595113A3678CF5D-MeleeCombatExtended and https://www.bohemia.net/community/licenses/arma-public-license. One-handed animation resources (MIT license): https://github.com/TonyFierce/Melee-Combat-Extended-Resources. Complete component notices are included.


Giant stomp animation: Giant Pack V01 by MandB Animation, retargeted and fitted for Reforger by Project Outbreak. Fab Standard License: https://www.fab.com/listings/6c958505-2e10-4600-b85c-668cd158d25d. Animation retargeting, native graph integration and authored adaptations are by Project Outbreak.


Crawling Ghoul Anims by RamsterZ: https://www.fab.com/listings/9e96b3f7-30ca-4221-a2eb-2bd46146b286. Climbing animation from Free Animation Library by voxel vision: https://www.fab.com/listings/481ef75b-892b-424f-a213-f1cc058c9c19. Spear throw from Cool Throwing Combat Animations by Bacengdu: https://www.fab.com/listings/fffbea69-14ff-499d-b85a-131171c1d6f8. These compiled derivatives retain the Fab Standard License; editable sources are excluded.


Workshop licence: Arma Public License (APL). Incorporated assets retain their original licences and credits; this listing does not grant additional rights to those assets. See the included notices for component terms.

Shared dual-strike animation: original Epic Games character motion acquired under the Fab Standard License, retargeted and fitted for CMAI. Source: https://www.fab.com/listings/8c4bac2c-f7f7-4632-a644-47f4e104f5d8. Compiled game content only; editable sources and standalone redistribution are excluded.
changelog:
1.8.0
Added optional shared support for giant creatures: world crushing, fitted stomp animations, grounded footstep effects and impacts that scale with distance.

Improved pursuit of retreating enemies and decisions after switching targets. Creature add-ons can choose area attacks from perceived groups and keep their cast while parking their own movement.

Barefoot creatures no longer injure their feet while walking or running. Normal human footwear and other damage keep their existing behavior.

World crushing and giant presentation remain off unless an add-on explicitly enables them. CMAI still requires only the Base Game.

Giant gameplay remains experimental. Complete multiplayer, late-join and presentation coverage is still in progress.

Improved carry cleanup when a carrier disappears or loses its settings. Delayed commands from an ended carry no longer replace a newer carry, and cleanup preserves unrelated character commands.

Shared Mushroom Rift animation bank: the fitted creature clips and attack graphs are supplied by CMAI, preserving their motion and resource identities.

Added optional per-hand melee contact and shared dual-strike animations for creature authors. Existing attacks retain their ordinary contact rules unless an addon enables hand windows.

name: AI Rearm
author: Project Outbreak
summary: AI Rearm lets AI request magazines from squadmates, recover compatible ammunition from allowed dead bodies, and visit arsenals. A placeable Game Master settings system controls settings.
description:
AI Rearm allows infantry AI to find more ammunition when their usable reserve runs low. It runs on the server and does not replace your scenario, game mode, faction, character prefabs, AI configuration, or group waypoints.

When a compatible soldier needs ammunition, AI Rearm can use three routes.

1. SQUAD SHARING

A safe, available AI squadmate can share compatible spare magazines through Reforger's physical drop-and-pickup behavior. AI Rearm protects the donor's reserve and confirms that the requester received usable ammunition.

2. DEAD-BODY RECOVERY

The AI can move to an allowed dead character and recover compatible magazines that still contain ammunition. The default policy uses friendly AI bodies only. Mission settings can also permit enemy, neutral, and dead player bodies. Incapacitated or revivable characters are never used as sources.

3. ARSENAL REARMING

The AI can find an enabled friendly or neutral arsenal, travel to it, and acquire a compatible magazine. Mission authors can use normal supply costs or make AI arsenal ammunition free. Arsenal access, item compatibility, stock, and inventory capacity are checked in both modes.

CUSTOM CONTENT SUPPORT

AI Rearm reads active weapons, magazine wells, inventory items, arsenal entries, and faction relationships at runtime. It has no faction-specific weapon table or magazine list.

The addon depends only on Arma Reforger. Compatibility has also been demonstrated with Bundeswehr Mod riflemen, G36 magazines, and arsenals without a Bundeswehr-specific adapter.

MISSION SETTINGS

The optional AI Rearm Mission Settings object is available in Game Master's Systems browser. Place one control box to configure:

- master enable or disable;
- automatic or custom low-ammo thresholds;
- automatic or custom target reserves;
- squad sharing, body recovery, and arsenal routes;
- friendly-AI-only or any-dead-body recovery;
- normal supply charging or free AI arsenal ammunition;
- body and arsenal search distances;
- `SAFE`-only or `SAFE` and `VIGILANT` operation;
- the ammunition reserve a donor must keep after sharing.

The controller is optional. Without one, AI Rearm uses its automatic weapon-based defaults. Mission authors can also place `Prefabs/Systems/AIRearm/AIR_AIRearmMissionSettings.et` in Workbench and edit the component values directly.

INSTALLATION

Enable AI Rearm for the scenario or server. Multiplayer servers must load the addon. No `SystemSettings` or scenario-prefab edit is required.

COMPATIBILITY

AI Rearm is designed for infantry AI and additive mods that use Reforger's standard AI, weapon, magazine, inventory, faction, and arsenal systems.

It does not manage player-controlled characters, wildlife, inactive AI, vehicle or turret ammunition, disposable weapons, virtual ammunition systems, custom AI replacements, or arsenal and currency systems that bypass the standard interfaces. Those systems may need a separate integration. Testing the intended mod combination before deployment is recommended.

name: Military Crossbow
author: Project Outbreak
summary: A standalone military crossbow with a four-bolt quiver, detachable scope and custom loading animation.
description:
Military Crossbow adds a handheld military crossbow, a four-bolt quiver and custom loading and re-cocking animation.

Find it in Game Master or the arsenal. Pick it up, aim and fire. The scope uses the normal optic rail and can be removed; flip-up iron sights stand up when it is off. Fired bolts can be picked up again.

This first release has focused PC gameplay evidence. Current multiplayer, JIP and AI use remain under validation.

The iron sights are based on "Iron Sight (FREE)" (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/iron-sight-free-3217e68522674fce9b24d8dae5d2c5b0) by Michael Karel (https://sketchfab.com/michaelkarel) licensed under CC-BY-4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).


LICENCE
The Arma Public Licence covers only our first-party work. It does not cover the crossbow model and textures (Azaq Game Art Studio, Fab Standard License), the iron sights, or sounds by ElevenLabs. Those stay under their original licences and may not be extracted or redistributed. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for full credits.
changelog: Fixes the sideways first-person crossbow after drawing or equipping it. Keeps the flat back placement, vanilla draw/restow, front quiver reload, palm-down single-bolt reload, fitted inspections, finishes and FIRE/HE ammunition. Standalone: no other Workshop addon required.

name: Ballista Turret WIP
author: Project Outbreak
summary: Introduces a mannable Ballista Crowssbow that can be used to kill and hunt dragons
description:
Introduces a mannable Ballista Crowssbow that can be used to kill and hunt dragons (if you so choose!)

Still WIP!

Model used under Fab Standard License: 
https://www.fab.com/listings/3dfd95d1-6f6f-4c06-a659-b2bd374b713a?lang=it
changelog:
Bigger bolts and a heavier sound.

- Increased ballista bolt damage by 1,000x, from 250 to 250,000. A successful hit can now kill the supported dragon in one shot.
- Added heavier release, winding and impact sounds for both mounts.
- AI gunners now hold a usable ballista station during combat instead of repeatedly walking away. Casualties and explicit exit orders still work normally.

The classic and modern military mounts both use these changes. Still WIP; multiplayer presentation and full-range crew posture need further testing.
